result.summary: The image depicts a wide multi-lane arterial road with mixed residential and commercial land uses. While sidewalks and a buffered bike lane are present, the environment is dominated by vehicle space with long crossing distances and no visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane roadway with additional parking and bike lanes creates a very long unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A wide curb cut for a commercial parking lot creates a point where vehicles may cross the pedestrian walkway at speed.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

result.summary: The environment features a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk separated from the roadway by a small grass buffer and street trees. While the walking path is clear, the lack of mid-block crossing infrastructure and the presence of a large driveway and parked vehicles create potential conflict points and sightline issues.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large parked truck on the right side of the image obstructs sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: A wide driveway/parking lot entrance crosses the sidewalk, creating a point of potential conflict between pedestrians and turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove on-street parking spaces immediately adjacent to the driveway and potential crossing points to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian-actuated beacon to provide a safe crossing point for the commercial destination.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the driveway or potential crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, multi-lane arterial road with sidewalks and a buffered bike lane. While pedestrian walkways are present and separated from traffic by a planting strip, the lack of marked crossings and the significant crossing distance create a challenging environment for pedestrians attempting to cross the street.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features continuous sidewalks along a mixed-use corridor, but lacks essential safety infrastructure like marked crossings or medians. High-speed potential and visual obstructions from parked vehicles create a moderately hostile environment for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.description: No designated crossing points are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without protection.
